row.label: Anonymous loot

row.label: Enable toggle hotkey
row.note: shown with its value as a greyed Info row - cannot be changed here
row.help: Enable toggle_key / toggle_gamepad_combo to switch ALL map icons on/off when the overlay is DISABLED. (When the overlay is enabled, they open it instead.)

row.label: Toggle key
row.help: Keyboard toggle: OPENS the config overlay when enable_overlay is on, or toggles ALL map icons on/off when the overlay is disabled. Default: F10.

row.label: Toggle gamepad combo
row.help: Gamepad toggle, same role as toggle_key: opens the overlay, or switches ALL map icons on/off when the overlay is disabled. In the menu you simply press the buttons you want. Editing this file by hand takes names joined with '+' (A, B, X, Y, LB, RB, L3, R3, BACK, START, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT). Default: Y+R3.

row.label: Manual marker hide
row.help: Hover a marker on the world map and press the hide key to hide it. Hidden markers persist and can be restored on the Hidden tab.

row.label: Hide-marker key
row.help: Key that hides the map marker currently under the cursor.

row.label: Hide-marker button
row.help: Gamepad button that hides the map marker under the cursor (same as the hide-marker key).

row.label: Marker hover info
row.help: While the map is open, show a small panel on the LEFT telling you how far above or below you the marker under the cursor sits. Its name is not repeated there - the game's own popup already shows it.

page.title: Progress
page.note: STRUCTURE is exact; the region ROWS above are examples. The real list is built at runtime: a marker's region comes from the dungeon tile map (generated::REGION_TILES, areas 10..45) or AREA_FALLBACK, and for the overworld from the marker's own baked location id - whose NAME is the game's own text, not ours. A region with zero markers is skipped, and the order is the sorted region list, not this file's order.
